insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Room rent eligibility is referenced as per Policy Schedule/Certificate of Insurance; proportionate deduction applies if higher room opted. Specific limit not stated in wording.

icu.note: ICU charges covered under inpatient care; specific cap not stated in wording, deferred to Policy Schedule.

copayment.note: Co-payment percentage specified in Policy Schedule/Certificate of Insurance; also 50% co-pay applies for Cyberknife/Robotic surgery for malignant tumors (Sec 3.1.1.28). Base co-pay not fixed in wording.

sub_limits.display: Sub-limits on specified illnesses/conditions per Policy Schedule
sub_limits.note: Section 3.1.1.20 provides for sub-limits on specified illnesses as per Policy Schedule. Annexure VII (list for sub-limits) is referenced but not populated in the wording. Robotic surgeries capped at ₹1L except specified procedures.

deductible.display: As per Policy Schedule (Annual Aggregate or Catastrophic Deductible options)
deductible.note: Two deductible options available: Annual Aggregate Deductible (Sec 3.1.1.25) and Annual Catastrophic Claim Deductible (Sec 3.1.1.26); amounts per Policy Schedule. Base plan may have zero deductible.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for illnesses from first policy commencement; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period stated as 'number of months as mentioned in Policy Schedule/Certificate of Insurance'. PED definition uses 36-month look-back. Exact waiting period not fixed in wording.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specific disease/procedure waiting period per Policy Schedule. Standard list includes cataract, hernia, kidney disease, etc. Exact months not fixed in wording; definition references up to 36 months.

maternity.display: Covered (waiting period as per Policy Schedule; family floater only)
maternity.note: Maternity covered under Sec 3.1.1.8 for family floater policies only; includes normal/C-section/complicated delivery; max 2 pregnancies lifetime; waiting period per Policy Schedule; newborn cover, pre/post natal, cord blood banking also available.

cumulative_bonus.note: No Claim Bonus added each claim-free year at rate per Policy Schedule; max 100% of Base Sum Insured. Bonus reduces by same % if claim made in expiring year.

restoration.display: Once/year up to 100% Base SI (unrelated illness)
restoration.note: Re-fill Benefit (Sec 3.1.1.23): up to 100% of Base SI restored once SI exhausted; cannot be used for same illness/complication already claimed in that year. Not available for maternity or health check-up claims.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for number of days specified in Policy Schedule/Certificate of Insurance.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for number of days specified in Policy Schedule/Certificate of Insurance.

day_care.note: Day care treatment covered per listed procedures (Sec 3.1.1.4); list attached to policy. OPD treatment and diagnostic services not included.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered (Sec 3.1.1.6) if patient cannot be moved to hospital or no room available; minimum 3 consecutive days; reimbursement only.

ayush.display: Covered (inpatient in AYUSH Hospital, up to sub-limit per Policy Schedule)
ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient treatment covered under Sec 3.1.1.5 (Ayurveda, Unani, Sidha, Homeopathy) in recognised AYUSH hospitals; limit per Policy Schedule. Yoga excluded from inpatient AYUSH cover.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor's inpatient harvesting expenses covered (Sec 3.1.1.7) when recipient is insured; donor's stay, screening, pre/post-hosp expenses excluded.

ambulance.display: Covered (reasonable & customary; non-network capped per Policy Schedule)
ambulance.note: Emergency ground ambulance covered at R&C charges for network providers; non-network capped per Policy Schedule. Air ambulance also covered. One transfer per hospitalisation.

modern_treatments.display: Covered; robotic surgeries capped at ₹1L (exceptions apply)
modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments listed (Sec 3.1.1.33) including robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemo, etc. Robotic surgeries sub-limited to ₹1L except prostatectomy, cardiac, partial nephrectomy, malignancy surgeries.

consumables.display: Not covered (listed as non-payable in Annexure III)
consumables.note: Gloves, masks, and many consumables explicitly listed as non-payable in Annexure III. No consumables rider mentioned.

global_cover.display: Optional (emergency evacuation, emergency hospitalisation, specified illness cover abroad)
global_cover.note: Section 3.5 provides international coverage options including emergency medical evacuation, emergency hospitalisation outside India, and specified illness cover abroad; available only in territories specified in Policy Schedule.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 30 days for all premium modes except monthly (15 days). Coverage available during grace period if premium paid in instalments.

free_look.note: 30-day free look period from date of receipt of policy document; applicable on new policies only, not renewals.

portability.note: Portability allowed per IRDAI norms; credits for PED waiting, specific waiting periods, NCB, moratorium transferable to new insurer.

notable_exclusions.display: Circumcision (non-medical), external congenital anomaly, dental/oral treatment, sleep disorders, STIs (non-HIV), off-label drugs, OPD treatment, multifocal lens, animal bite (unless opted)

optional_riders.display: Critical illness cover (Basic/Intermediate/Advanced/Women/Child), Accidental cover, Hospital cash, OPD cover, International cover, Re-fill benefit, Loyalty credits, Wellness/health coaching
